exercises.instructionEn: Write questions for the answers. Then, in pairs, act out the dialogue.
exercises.instructionUz: Javoblarga savol yozing. So'ng juftlikda dialogni ijro eting.
exercises.explanationUz:
JAVOBGA QARAB SAVOL TUZISH:

  1) Javobning QAYSI qismi YANGI ma'lumot — shuni aniqlang
  2) O'sha qismga mos SAVOL SO'ZINI tanlang
  3) To'g'ri YORDAMCHI fe'lni qo'ying

IKKI XIL YORDAMCHI FE'L:

  'BE' fe'li bilan → WAS/WERE ('did' KERAK EMAS)
     When WAS he BORN?
     Where WAS he BORN?
     What WAS he famous FOR?

  Boshqa fe'llar bilan → DID + ASOSIY shakl
     Where DID he STUDY?
     When DID he RECEIVE ...?
     Where DID he DIE?
     When DID he DIE?

ALBERT EYNSHTEYN HAQIDA:
  Nemis-amerikalik fizik (1879-1955).
  Nisbiylik nazariyasini yaratgan.
  1921-yilda fizika bo'yicha Nobel mukofotini olgan.

YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a theory       = nazariya
  relativity     = nisbiylik
  the Polytechnic Academy = Politexnika akademiyasi
  Zurich         = Sirix (Shveytsariya shahri)
  New Jersey     = Nyu-Jersi (AQSh shtati)

items.answer: Albert Einstein was born on 14th March, 1879.
items.question: When was Albert Einstein born?
items.whyUz:
Yangi ma'lumot — SANA → WHEN.
'be born' → WAS ('did' KERAK EMAS).

items.question: Where was he born?
items.whyUz:
Yangi ma'lumot — JOY → WHERE.
'be born' → WAS.

items.answer: He studied at the Polytechnic Academy in Zurich.
items.question: Where did he study?
items.whyUz:
Yangi ma'lumot — JOY → WHERE.
'study' — oddiy fe'l → DID + ASOSIY shakl ('study').
'did he studied' XATO.

items.answer: He was famous for his theory of relativity.
items.question: What was he famous for?
items.whyUz:
Yangi ma'lumot — NIMA UChUN mashhur → WHAT ... FOR?
'famous FOR' — 'for' gap OXIRIDA qoladi.
'was' → 'did' KERAK EMAS.
'a theory of relativity' = nisbiylik nazariyasi.

items.answer: He received the Nobel Prize for Physics in 1921.
items.question: When did he receive the Nobel Prize for Physics?
items.whyUz:
Yangi ma'lumot — SANA → WHEN.
'receive' — oddiy fe'l → DID + ASOSIY shakl ('receive').
Boshqa varianti: 'What did he receive in 1921?'

items.answer: He died in New Jersey, USA.
items.question: Where did he die?
items.whyUz:
Yangi ma'lumot — JOY → WHERE.
'die' — oddiy fe'l → DID + ASOSIY shakl ('die').
'did he died' XATO.

items.question: When did he die?
items.whyUz:
Yangi ma'lumot — SANA → WHEN.
6-band bilan solishtiring: u yerda JOY, bu yerda SANA —
ikkalasida ham bir xil fe'l ('die').

exercises.instructionEn: Complete the text with verbs from the list in the past simple.
exercises.instructionUz: Matnni ro'yxatdagi fe'llarning oddiy o'tgan zamon shakli bilan to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT (13 ta fe'l, 13 ta bo'shliq):
  move, return, study, continue, leave, become, star,
  win, go, divorce, die, marry, be

Har biri AYNAN BIR MARTA ishlatiladi.

TO'LIQ MATN (to'ldirilgan holda):

  Ingrid Bergman WAS a famous Swedish actress. She was born
  on 29th August, 1915, in Stockholm.

  Ingrid STUDIED at the Royal Dramatic Theatre in
  Stockholm. She WENT to Hollywood in 1939. She BECAME
  famous for her starring role in the classic film
  Casablanca. In 1950, she MARRIED Roberto Rossellini and
  MOVED to Europe. She CONTINUED her acting career there
  and STARRED in French and Italian films. In 1956, she
  DIVORCED Rossellini and LEFT Europe. She RETURNED to
  Hollywood and WON three awards for Best Actress.

  Ingrid Bergman DIED on 29th August, 1982, in London.


O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI:
  Ingrid Bergman mashhur shved aktrisasi edi. U 1915-yil
  29-avgustda Stokgolmda tug'ilgan.
  Ingrid Stokgolmdagi Qirollik dramatik teatrida o'qidi.
  1939-yilda Gollivudga ketdi. 'Kasablanka' klassik
  filmidagi bosh roli bilan mashhur bo'ldi. 1950-yilda
  Roberto Rossellinига turmushga chiqdi va Yevropaga
  ko'chib o'tdi. U yerda aktyorlik faoliyatini davom
  ettirdi va fransuz va italyan filmlarida bosh rollarda
  o'ynadi. 1956-yilda Rossellinидан ajrashdi va Yevropani
  tark etdi. Gollivudga qaytdi va 'Eng yaxshi aktrisa'
  nominatsiyasida uchta mukofot yutdi.
  Ingrid Bergman 1982-yil 29-avgustda Londonda vafot etdi.


QIZIQ FAKT:
  Ingrid Bergman AYNAN o'zining tug'ilgan kunida vafot
  etgan — 29-avgust. 67 yoshga to'lgan kuni.

NOTO'G'RI FE'LLAR BU MATNDA:
  be    → WAS
  go    → WENT
  become → BECAME
  leave → LEFT
  win   → WON

TO'G'RI FE'LLAR:
  studied, married, moved, continued, starred,
  divorced, returned, died

DIQQAT — 'STARRED':
  star → STARRED ('r' IKKILANADI).
  40-betdagi 5-mashqning 5-bandida ham bor edi.

YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  Swedish        = shved
  a dramatic theatre = dramatik teatr
  a starring role = bosh rol
  classic        = klassik
  an acting career = aktyorlik faoliyati
  an award       = mukofot
  Best Actress   = eng yaxshi aktrisa

items.textEn: 1  Ingrid Bergman ............ a famous Swedish actress.
items.whyUz:
be → WAS (noto'g'ri fe'l).
Kasb aytilyapti → 'to be' kerak.
'Swedish' = shved.

items.textEn: 2  Ingrid ............ at the Royal Dramatic Theatre in Stockholm.
items.whyUz:
study → STUDIED ('d' undosh + 'y' → -IED).
'study AT' — predlog AT.

go → WENT (noto'g'ri fe'l).
'go TO a place' — predlog TO.
18-mashqning 3-bandi shu gapga asoslanadi.

items.textEn: 4  She ............ famous for her starring role in the classic film Casablanca.
items.whyUz:
become → BECAME (noto'g'ri fe'l).
'become famous FOR something' = biror narsa bilan
mashhur bo'lmoq.
'a starring role' = bosh rol.
'Casablanca' (1942) — Bergmanning eng mashhur filmi.

marry → MARRIED ('r' undosh + 'y' → -IED).
DIQQAT: 'married WITH' XATO.
Roberto Rossellini — italyan kinorejissori.

move → moved (oxiri 'e' → faqat + D).
'move TO a place' = biror joyga ko'chib o'tmoq.
3-band bilan solishtiring: 'went' (bordi) ↔
'moved' (ko'chib o'tdi).

continue → continued (oxiri 'e' → faqat + D).
'an acting career' = aktyorlik faoliyati.

items.textEn: 8  ... and ............ in French and Italian films.
items.hintUz: 'in ... films' — bosh rolda o'ynash; undosh IKKILANADI
items.whyUz:
star → STARRED ('r' IKKILANADI).
'star IN a film' — predlog IN.
17-mashqning 5-tuzatish bandi shu gapga asoslanadi:
nemis va ispan emas, FRANSUZ va ITALYAN filmlari.

divorce → divorced (oxiri 'e' → faqat + D).
17-mashqning 6-tuzatish bandi shu gapga asoslanadi:
1982 emas, 1956.

leave → LEFT (noto'g'ri fe'l).
'leave a place' — PREDLOG KERAK EMAS:
  left Europe        ✓
  left FROM Europe   ✗ XATO

return → returned (to'g'ri fe'l).
'return TO a place' — predlog TO.
3-band bilan bog'liq: 1939-da bordi, 1956-da QAYTDI.

items.textEn: 12  ... and ............ three awards for Best Actress.
items.hintUz: Mukofot bilan nima qilinadi?; noto'g'ri fe'l
items.whyUz:
win → WON (noto'g'ri fe'l), o'qilishi /wʌn/.
'win an award' = mukofot yutmoq.
'an award' = mukofot;  'Best Actress' = eng yaxshi aktrisa.

items.textEn: 13  Ingrid Bergman ............ on 29th August, 1982, in London.
items.whyUz:
die → died (to'g'ri fe'l).
QIZIQ FAKT: u AYNAN tug'ilgan kunida (29-avgust)
vafot etgan — 67 yoshga to'lgan kuni.
17-mashqning 7-tuzatish bandi shu gapga asoslanadi.

exercises.instructionEn: Then, correct the sentences as in the example.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  1  She was born in London.
     She WASN'T born in London. She WAS born in Stockholm.

QOLIP (IKKI GAP):
  Ega + INKOR + noto'g'ri ma'lumot.
  Ega + TASDIQ + to'g'ri ma'lumot.

IKKI XIL INKOR:

  'BE' fe'li bilan → WASN'T ('didn't' KERAK EMAS)
     She WASN'T born in London.

  Boshqa fe'llar bilan → DIDN'T + ASOSIY shakl
     She DIDN'T MOVE to Hollywood in 1915.
     She DIDN'T MARRY Rossellini in 1939.

TASDIQ qismida esa O'TGAN shakl:
     She MOVED / WENT to Hollywood in 1939.
     She MARRIED him in 1950.

Bir javobda IKKI xil shakl!

items.answer: She wasn't born in London. She was born in Stockholm.
items.whyUz:
'be born' → WASN'T ('didn't' KERAK EMAS).
Matnda: 'She was born ... in STOCKHOLM'.

items.answer: She didn't move to Hollywood in 1915. She went to Hollywood in 1939.
items.hintUz: Qaysi yil? 1915 — bu nima yili edi?
items.whyUz:
Matnda: 'She WENT to Hollywood in 1939'.
1915 — u TUG'ILGAN yil.
Inkorda 'didn't MOVE' (asosiy shakl),
tasdiqda 'WENT' (o'tgan shakl).

items.textEn: 3  She became famous for her starring role in the classic film Gone With the Wind.
items.answer: She didn't become famous for her starring role in Gone With the Wind. She became famous for her starring role in Casablanca.
items.whyUz:
Matnda: 'the classic film CASABLANCA'.
'Gone With the Wind' — boshqa mashhur film (Vivien Leigh).
Inkorda 'didn't BECOME', tasdiqda 'BECAME'.

items.answer: She didn't marry Roberto Rossellini in 1939. She married him in 1950.
items.hintUz: Qaysi yil? 1939 — bu nima yili edi?
items.whyUz:
Matnda: 'In 1950, she MARRIED Roberto Rossellini'.
1939 — u Gollivudga KETGAN yil.
Inkorda 'didn't MARRY', tasdiqda 'MARRIED'.

items.textEn: 5  She starred in German and Spanish films in Europe.
items.answer: She didn't star in German and Spanish films. She starred in French and Italian films.
items.whyUz:
Matnda: 'STARRED in FRENCH and ITALIAN films'.
Inkorda 'didn't STAR' (asosiy shakl, 'starred' EMAS),
tasdiqda 'STARRED'.

items.answer: She didn't divorce Rossellini in 1982. She divorced him in 1956.
items.hintUz: Qaysi yil? 1982 — bu nima yili edi?
items.whyUz:
Matnda: 'In 1956, she DIVORCED Rossellini'.
1982 — u VAFOT ETGAN yil.
Inkorda 'didn't DIVORCE', tasdiqda 'DIVORCED'.

items.textEn: 7  She died on 29th August, 1992, in Paris.
items.answer: She didn't die on 29th August, 1992, in Paris. She died on 29th August, 1982, in London.
items.hintUz: IKKI xato: yil ham, shahar ham
items.whyUz:
Matnda: 'DIED on 29th August, 1982, in LONDON'.
IKKI xato: 1992 emas 1982, Parij emas London.
KUN va OY to'g'ri (29-avgust).
Inkorda 'didn't DIE', tasdiqda 'DIED'.

exercises.instructionEn: Write questions for the answers below, as in the example.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  1  When and where WAS SHE BORN?
     She was born on 29th August, 1915, in Stockholm.

Savol so'zi KITOBDA BERILGAN — siz qolganini
to'ldirasiz.

IKKI XIL YORDAMCHI FE'L:
  'be born' → WAS ('did' KERAK EMAS)
  boshqa fe'l → DID + ASOSIY shakl

DIQQAT — 'WHEN AND WHERE':
  Ikki savol birga berilsa, yordamchi fe'l BIR MARTA:
     When and where was she born?     ✓
     When was and where was she born? ✗

items.answer: She was born on 29th August, 1915, in Stockholm.
items.question: When and where was she born?
items.whyUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA.
'be born' → WAS ('did' KERAK EMAS).
'When and where' — ikki savol birga, fe'l bir marta.

items.answer: She studied at the Royal Dramatic Theatre.
items.question: Where did she study?
items.whyUz:
Savol so'zi 'Where' kitobda berilgan.
'study' — oddiy fe'l → DID + ASOSIY shakl.
'did she studied' XATO.

items.question: When did she go to Hollywood?
items.whyUz:
Savol so'zi 'When' kitobda berilgan.
'go' → DID + GO (asosiy shakl, 'went' EMAS).

items.question: Who did she marry?
items.whyUz:
Savol so'zi 'Who' kitobda berilgan.
DIQQAT: bu yerda 'who' TO'LDIRUVChI ('kimga?') →
'did' KERAK.
40-betdagi 6-mashq bilan solishtiring: u yerda 'who'
EGA edi → 'did' yo'q edi.

items.answer: She died on 29th August, 1982, in London.
items.question: When and where did she die?
items.whyUz:
Savol so'zi 'When and where' kitobda berilgan.
'die' — oddiy fe'l → DID + DIE (asosiy shakl).
1-band bilan SOLISHTIRING:
  'was she BORN?'  ('be born' → was)
  'did she DIE?'   (oddiy fe'l → did)

exercises.instructionEn: Use the information in the chart below to write a biography about Dame Margot Fonteyn.
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi jadvaldagi ma'lumotdan foydalanib Dame Margo Fonteyn haqida tarjimai hol yozing.
exercises.explanationUz:
JADVALDAGI MA'LUMOT:

  ┌───────────────┬──────────────────────────────────────┐
  │ Name:         │ Dame Margot Fonteyn                  │
  ├───────────────┼──────────────────────────────────────┤
  │ Occupation:   │ ballet dancer                        │
  ├───────────────┼──────────────────────────────────────┤
  │ Born on:      │ 18th May, 1919, in Surrey, England   │
  ├───────────────┼──────────────────────────────────────┤
  │ Studied at:   │ the Sadler's Wells Ballet school     │
  ├───────────────┼──────────────────────────────────────┤
  │ Important     │ 1939 — danced the part of Aurora in  │
  │ dates:        │        The Sleeping Beauty           │
  │               │ 1954 — became president of the Royal │
  │               │        Academy of Dancing            │
  │               │ 1955 — married Robert Emilio Arias   │
  │               │ 1979 — wrote A Dancer's World and    │
  │               │        The Magic of Dance            │
  ├───────────────┼──────────────────────────────────────┤
  │ About her     │ died 21st February, 1991, in Panama  │
  │ death:        │ City, Panama                         │
  └───────────────┴──────────────────────────────────────┘

TARJIMAI HOL TUZILISHI (Coursebook 75-betdagi rejadan):
  1-xatboshi: ism, kasbi, tug'ilgan sana va joy
  2-xatboshi: muhim sanalar XRONOLOGIK tartibda
  3-xatboshi: vafoti haqida


TO'LIQ NAMUNA MATN:

  Dame Margot Fonteyn was a famous British ballet dancer.
  She was born on 18th May, 1919, in Surrey, England.

  She studied at the Sadler's Wells Ballet school. In 1939,
  she danced the part of Aurora in The Sleeping Beauty. In
  1954, she became president of the Royal Academy of
  Dancing. She married Robert Emilio Arias in 1955. In
  1979, she wrote A Dancer's World and The Magic of Dance.

  Margot Fonteyn died on 21st February, 1991, in Panama
  City, Panama.


O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI:
  Dame Margo Fonteyn mashhur britaniyalik balet raqqosasi
  edi. U 1919-yil 18-mayda Angliyaning Surrey grafligida
  tug'ilgan.
  U Sadler's Wells balet maktabida o'qidi. 1939-yilda
  'Uxlayotgan go'zal' baletida Avrora rolini raqsga tushdi.
  1954-yilda Qirollik raqs akademiyasining prezidenti
  bo'ldi. 1955-yilda Robert Emilio Ariasga turmushga chiqdi.
  1979-yilda 'Raqqosaning dunyosi' va 'Raqs sehri'
  kitoblarini yozdi.
  Margo Fonteyn 1991-yil 21-fevralda Panamaning Panama-Siti
  shahrida vafot etdi.


DIQQAT — NOTO'G'RI FE'LLAR:
  become → BECAME
  write  → WROTE
  Qolganlari to'g'ri: studied, danced, married, died.

DIQQAT — 'DAME':
  'Dame' — britaniyalik ayolga beriladigan sharafli unvon
  (erkaklar uchun 'Sir').
  Ism bilan birga yoziladi va artikl OLMAYDI.

DIQQAT — SANA PREDLOGLARI:
  ON + aniq sana    on 18th May, 1919
  IN + faqat yil    in 1939, in 1954
  IN + joy          in Surrey, in Panama City
  AT + maktab       at the Sadler's Wells Ballet school

YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  an occupation = kasb, mashg'ulot
  a part        = rol (spektakl yoki baletda)
  The Sleeping Beauty = 'Uxlayotgan go'zal' (balet)
  a president   = prezident, rais
  an academy    = akademiya
  magic         = sehr
  Panama        = Panama (Markaziy Amerika davlati)

MARGO FONTEYN HAQIDA:
  XX asrning eng mashhur britaniyalik balerinasi.
  Rudolf Nureyev bilan birga raqsga tushgan —
  Nureyev Coursebook 70-betdagi 1-mashqda bor edi.

structure.heading: Para 1  Ism, kasb, tug'ilishi
structure.headingUz: 1-xatboshi: Ism, kasbi, tug'ilgan sana va joy
structure.guideUz:
'was a famous + millat + kasb'.
'was born ON + sana, IN + joy'.
Jadvalning Name, Occupation va Born on qatorlaridan.
structure.modelEn: Dame Margot Fonteyn was a famous British ballet dancer. She was born on 18th May, 1919, in Surrey, England.

structure.heading: Para 2a  Ta'limi
structure.modelEn: She studied at the Sadler's Wells Ballet school.

structure.heading: Para 2b  1939 — birinchi katta roli
structure.guideUz:
'In + yil, she + o'tgan fe'l'.
'dance the part of ...' = ... rolini raqsga tushmoq.
structure.modelEn: In 1939, she danced the part of Aurora in The Sleeping Beauty.

structure.heading: Para 2c  1954 — prezident
structure.guideUz:
become → BECAME (noto'g'ri fe'l).
'become president OF ...' — unvon oldidan artikl YO'Q.
structure.modelEn: In 1954, she became president of the Royal Academy of Dancing.

structure.heading: Para 2d  1955 — nikoh
structure.guideUz:
'married + kim' — 'with' KERAK EMAS.
Yilni gap oxirida ham berish mumkin.
structure.modelEn: She married Robert Emilio Arias in 1955.

structure.heading: Para 2e  1979 — kitoblari
structure.guideUz:
write → WROTE (noto'g'ri fe'l).
Ikki kitob nomini 'and' bilan bog'lang.
structure.modelEn: In 1979, she wrote A Dancer's World and The Magic of Dance.

structure.heading: Para 3  Vafoti
structure.guideUz:
'died ON + sana, IN + joy'.
Jadvalning 'About her death' qatoridan.
structure.modelEn: Margot Fonteyn died on 21st February, 1991, in Panama City, Panama.

wordFormation.introUz: 43-bet — savol tuzish, kino va balet lug'ati.

groups.ruleUz: SAVOL TUZISH — 'be' fe'li yoki oddiy fe'l
LEAVE, MOVE, RETURN, GO — harakat fe'llari

items.derived: arrive in a city / at a place

patterns.formula: WHEN / WHERE WAS + ega + BORN?   ↔   WHEN / WHERE DID + ega + DIE?
patterns.exampleEn: When was Albert Einstein born? Where did he die?
patterns.exampleUz: Albert Eynshteyn qachon tug'ilgan? U qayerda vafot etgan?

patterns.explanationUz:
'famous FOR' — 'for' gap OXIRIDA qoladi.
'was' → 'did' KERAK EMAS.

patterns.formula: Ega + DIDN'T + ASOSIY fe'l + noto'g'ri. Ega + O'TGAN fe'l + to'g'ri.
patterns.exampleEn: She didn't marry Roberto Rossellini in 1939. She married him in 1950.
patterns.exampleUz: U 1939-yilda Roberto Rossellinига turmushga chiqmagan. U 1950-yilda turmushga chiqqan.
patterns.explanationUz: Inkorda ASOSIY shakl, tasdiqda O'TGAN shakl.

patterns.formula: Ega + WASN'T + ... . Ega + WAS + ... .   ('be' fe'li uchun)
patterns.exampleEn: She wasn't born in London. She was born in Stockholm.
patterns.exampleUz: U Londonda tug'ilmagan. U Stokgolmda tug'ilgan.

patterns.exampleEn: She became famous for her starring role in Casablanca.
patterns.exampleUz: U 'Kasablanka' dagi bosh roli bilan mashhur bo'ldi.

patterns.exampleEn: In 1939, she danced the part of Aurora in The Sleeping Beauty.
patterns.exampleUz: 1939-yilda u 'Uxlayotgan go'zal' baletida Avrora rolini raqsga tushdi.
patterns.explanationUz:
Tarjimai holda voqealar XRONOLOGIK tartibda,
her biri yil bilan boshlanadi.

patterns.formula: Ega + LEFT + joy (predlogsiz) AND RETURNED TO + joy.
patterns.exampleEn: She divorced Rossellini and left Europe. She returned to Hollywood.
patterns.exampleUz: U Rossellinидан ajrashdi va Yevropani tark etdi. Gollivudga qaytdi.
